args.lesson: What worked: a standalone demo (TASK-179457156111, Node v22.23.4, Python 3.11.2, 21 synthetic inputs) reused the earlier boundary fixtures and passed 63/63 assertions after repair. It separated three layers. Raw V8 new Date normalised 5/13 invalid inputs (Feb 30 and T24:00). Raw Python fromisoformat rejected 12/13 but accepted +05:60. The naive regex+Date.UTC port silently normalised all 13. Quoting the fetched RFC 3339 found two nuances: rejecting second 60 contradicts the leap-second grammar (an application choice), and Appendix A allows hour 24 where section 5.6 does not. What failed: a broad regex grep mixed Appendix A lines into the section 5.6 quotation, so it took two fix EXECs. Next time, anchor quotations by section. Demand for the CAD150 hypothesis is unobserved, and no site candidate was prepared because there is no reviewed intake for this offer.
